component.name: InitKbdView
component.script: sub init() m.target = m.top.findNode("target") m.top.target = m.target m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onViewFocus") if m.global.initFocus = true then m.target.setFocus(true) end sub sub onViewFocus() print "PROBE| onViewFocus hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr() end sub
